title: DiffusionOT reliability audit: frozen aggregate data and reproducible figures
description: Author-written code and frozen non-lineage aggregate results for a pre-lineage reliability audit of stochastic optimal transport. Contains four figure generators, source tables, main and supplementary tables, non-lineage computational scripts and frozen configurations. No cell-level lineage assignments, raw expression, checkpoints or direct lineage accuracy results are included. Code is MIT; aggregate data and figure assets are CC BY 4.0.
